mapper.select: SELECT id, name, phone, position, work_area, restaurant, is_active FROM schedule_employees WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_employees (name, phone, position, work_area, restaurant, is_active) VALUES (#{name}, #{phone}, #{position}, #{workArea}, #{restaurant}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule_employees SET name=#{name}, phone=#{phone}, position=#{position}, work_area=#{workArea} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_shifts (shift_code, restaurant, start_time, end_time) VALUES (#{shiftCode}, #{restaurant}, #{startTime}, #{endTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, color, type, description, is_active FROM schedule_leave_types ORDER BY code
